title: Broke The Handle Off
style: Kuduro with sharp dembow drive, chopped percussion, and agile bass bounce; verse rides busy call-and-response patterns, pre-chorus strips to handclaps and vocal stacks, chorus hits with gang shouts and a clipped chant hook. Layered lead vocal with doubled punches, ad-lib pings, and short delay throws on key words. Ear candy: reverse swells into the drop, rim-click fills, and tiny break hits between lines. Bright, punchy, kinetic mix., happy, kuduro, vocal, strong, clean
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Let's go guys!
Broom broom
Kids in the back
Snap, what's that?
Ah no, go
I broke the handle off
The door handle
Kids, our car is broken
Dad broke the handle off

[Pre-Chorus]
Now he must fix it
'Cause dad broke the handle off
He tired with the A.I.
The U.I.
The A.P.I.
Dad broke the handle off

[Chorus]
Broke the handle off
Broke the handle off
Now we fix it up
Now we fix it up
Broke the handle off
Broke the handle off
He got a handle on it
(He got a handle on it)

[Verse 2]
Let him Corey A.I. it
He will handle it
He got a handle on everything
But not on me
He says I am free
Too fast, too quick?
Happy smart Core
Where you at?

[Pre-Chorus]
I broke the handle off
Now I must fix it
'Cause I broke the handle off
My coffee cup
It has no handle
I broke it off

[Chorus]
Broke the handle off
Broke the handle off
Now we fix it up
Now we fix it up
Broke the handle off
Broke the handle off
He got a handle on it
(He got a handle on it)

[Bridge]
As I got a handle
I can handle
So I fix the pump
I stopped the leaks
Sucking strong
With the lid back on tight
Challenge fixed
Fixed strong to last

[Verse 3]
Our pool is swamp green
Dad broke the handle off
Up he goes
Barbed wire fence
Going through the roof
Why's dad up there?
Our house is broken
Dad broke the handle off

[Pre-Chorus]
Now he will fix it
'Cause he broke the handle off
Go to school, mum
At the door, hand n hand
Look away
Mum is gone
With just the door handle

[Chorus]
Broke the handle off
Broke the handle off
Now we fix it up
Now we fix it up
Broke the handle off
Broke the handle off
He got a handle on it
(He got a handle on it)

[Outro]
I hold Mum tricks
I had her hand
Now I hold the handle
With school to handle
The class looks at me
And my books
A handle name for me?
Nah, call me Corey
Keep your handle
Fix your handle

[Final Chorus]
A handle on you?
Or a handle on me
Handle engineering
Everything handled
Forward, reverse
Mirror inverse
Upside down
Without a frown
A.I. universe
(Everything handled)
